name: Adventure Story!
desc:
A multiplayer, turn-based action-adventure game set in a cartoony world full of interesting and charming characters. You travel the world to learn powerful abilities in order to conquer the most evil beings with the help of your friends, while collecting treasures and valuable relics along the way.

--------------------------------------------------------

2026 changes:
- Fixed lots of issues, optimized some things, slight battle improvements
- Reset dungeon ratings and fixed generation issues with it
- Increased card drop rates from 1 in 8 to 1 in 2
- Increased corrupted enemy rates when at max level
- Fixed fleeing, made some battle camera movements faster
- Dungeon difficulty is now total of player ratings instead of combined average
- Dungeon rating on victory is no longer split between each player
- Endless dungeons now scale faster based on number of players
